searchText: Hey <@881905303011086387>, I am just currently in the process of implementing parts of the `p2p-interface.md` for `Phase0`, however, I was wondering whether light clients need to add `attnets` entry in their ENR record? The `p2p-interface.md` in `altair/light-client` does not mention any specific requirements regarding the ENR records for light clients trying to connect using Libp2p. <etan_status> no ENR changes, the idea is that over time the majority of full nodes just serve the data <uink45> Thanks that makes sense!

Hey <@881905303011086387>, I am just currently in the process of implementing parts of the `p2p-interface.md` for `Phase0`, however, I was wondering whether light clients need to add `attnets` entry in their ENR record? 

The `p2p-interface.md` in `altair/light-client` does not mention any specific requirements regarding the ENR records for light clients trying to connect using Libp2p.

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <etan_status> no ENR changes, the idea is that over time the majority of full nodes just serve the data
